text:
Claire Park: Pulled together notes from the UX review — proposing a compact validation pattern for the console that reduces noise but stays accessible. Thoughts?

Diego Morales: Short version: inline for local/syntax checks, top summary for submit-time or interdependent rules. +1 for compactness.

Priya Shah: Accessibility: inline errors should use role=alert or aria-live polite so AT users get immediate feedback. The summary should receive focus on submit failure and announce the count.

Tom Becker: Required marker idea: instead of filling every label with an asterisk, use a small "Required" label for priority fields (email, billing) and a single footnote "* required" on longer forms. Keeps form scanning easier.

Claire Park: Agree on the hybrid approach. Also: inline error triggers on blur and on submit; summary only appears after first failed submit. Summary items must link to the field anchor.

Diego Morales: UX detail for inline errors: show a subtle red icon + concise message (1 line) and an example when helpful. Do not show verbose validation rules inline.

Priya Shah: A11y checklist I'll add to the doc: aria-describedby linking input -> error, visible focus when jumping from summary, color contrast for icons, no color-only signals, and screen-reader-only text for required markers.

Tom Becker: Delete flow proposal: three tiers:
1) Low risk: immediate delete + undo toast (5s).
2) Medium risk: modal with clear consequences + opt-in checkbox "I understand".
3) High risk: typed confirm matching full resource path.

Claire Park: Example copy for medium modal: 
"Delete model snapshot"
"This will remove snapshot 'exp-2026-03-21' from storage and cannot be recovered."
Checkbox: "I understand this action is permanent."
Primary: "Delete snapshot"

Diego Morales: For typed confirm, require typing the resource name in a dedicated input (no paste) and disable the confirm button until typed exactly. This prevents accidental confirmations.

Priya Shah: Mobile/compact rules: collapse the summary behind a single-line banner that expands. Ensure each expanded item opens the keyboard and scrolls the field into view.

forms-bot: Added "forms-validation-guidelines.md" to the design docs with these patterns and a11y checklist: https://redwood.internal/design/forms-validation-guidelines :white_check_mark:

Claire Park: Awesome. Action items: Priya add the A11y checklist to the repo, Diego make small comps for the pill/footnote patterns, Tom prototyping the three-tier delete UX. I'll update components page after those land. Thanks! :sparkles:
